items.title: 8.1.5 Advanced Information Retrieval Techniques (search engines, keywords, Boolean operators, advanced search features) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.1.5 (PDF 197-198) with the Boolean Venn figure (RU only), MCQ 2 and short question 5 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Agar advanced techniques (aage ke, behtar tareeqe) istemal karein to online maloomat dhoondna zyada effective (kaam ka) ho jata hai. Yeh tareeqe search engines se behtar results lene aur bilkul wahi cheez dhoondne mein madad dete hain jo aap ko chahiye.
Effective Use of Search Engines

Google jaise search engines maloomat dhoondne ke taqatwar tools hain. Inhein achhi tarah istemal karne ke liye yeh aana chahiye ke apni search query (talash ke alfaaz) is tarah likhein ke sab se achhe results milein.

Misal: kisi ko traditional (purane, ghar wale) Pakistani khanon ki recipes chahiye. Sirf “recipes” likhne ki bajaye woh “traditional pakistani recipes” likhe to zyada khaas (specific) results milenge.
Choosing Effective Keywords

Keywords woh alfaaz hain jo aap search engine mein type karte hain. Sahi keywords chunne se kaam ki (relevant) maloomat jaldi milti hai. Sochein ke aap ke topic se sab se aham alfaaz kaunse hain, aur wahi search mein likhein.
Misal: Punjab ka ek kisan “organic farming techniques” seekhna chahta hai. Sirf “farming” ki bajaye “organic farming” keywords likhne se use zyada relevant maloomat milegi.
Using Boolean Operators ("AND", "OR", "NOT")
Boolean operators khaas alfaaz hain jo search ko refine (chhaant kar behtar) karte hain. Yeh teen hain: “AND”, “OR” aur “NOT”.

items: AND: search mein kai alfaaz ek saath shamil karne ke liye. Misal: “agriculture AND irrigation” search karein to sirf woh results aayenge jin mein dono alfaaz hon.
OR: aise results ke liye jin mein dono mein se koi bhi ek lafz ho. Misal: “Crops OR vegetables” woh results dikhayega jin mein koi ek (ya dono) lafz ho.
NOT: kisi lafz ko search se nikalne (exclude karne) ke liye. Misal: “Farming NOT pesticides” farming ke woh results dikhayega jin mein pesticides (keera maar dawaiyon) ka zikr na ho.

blocks.alt: Teen qataron mein do do daire (Venn diagram). AND: 'agriculture' aur 'irrigation' ke dairon ka sirf beech ka common (saanjha) hissa neela, yani dono alfaaz wale pages. OR: 'crops' aur 'vegetables' ke dono poore daire neele, yani koi ek ya dono alfaaz wale pages. NOT: 'farming' ka daira neela magar 'pesticides' wala common hissa safed, yani farming wale pages pesticides ke baghair.
blocks.caption: Boolean operators AND, OR aur NOT: neela hissa woh nateeje hain jo search wapas deta hai (kitab ki misalon ka asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har daira (circle) ek lafz wale web pages hain. AND search ko tang (narrow) karta hai: sirf woh pages jin mein dono alfaaz hon. OR search ko wide (khula) karta hai: kisi ek lafz wale pages bhi aa jate hain. NOT ek lafz wale pages nikal deta hai, is liye 'farming' ke daire se 'pesticides' wala hissa kat jata hai.
Khud chala kar dekhein

Yeh program kuch titles ki list mein search engine ki tarah Boolean search karta hai. operator ko "AND", "OR" ya "NOT" kar ke, ya word1 aur word2 badal kar Run karein aur dekhein ke results kaise kam ya zyada hote hain.

titles = ["Agriculture and irrigation in Punjab", "Irrigation canals of Pakistan", "Agriculture of wheat", "Winter crops guide", "Fresh vegetables at home", "Modern farming tools", "Farming and pesticides"]
word1 = "agriculture"
word2 = "irrigation"
operator = "AND"        # "AND", "OR" ya "NOT"

print("Search:", word1, operator, word2)
results = list()
for title in titles:
    has1 = word1.lower() in title.lower()
    has2 = word2.lower() in title.lower()
    if operator == "AND":
        match = has1 and has2
    elif operator == "OR":
        match = has1 or has2
    else:                          # NOT: word1 ho magar word2 na ho
        match = has1 and not has2
    if match:
        print(" -", title)
        results.append(title)
print("Kul results:", len(results))

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"titles": saat titles ki list, jaise search engine ke paas pages hon.
"word1", "word2" aur "operator": dhoondne wale do alfaaz aur Boolean operator (AND, OR ya NOT).
"results = list()": milne wale titles yahan jama honge.
"has1 = word1.lower() in title.lower()": dono ko chhote harfon mein kar ke dekhta hai ke title mein word1 hai ya nahi (True/False); capital/small ka farq khatam.
"if operator == "AND": match = has1 and has2": dono alfaaz hon tabhi match.
"elif operator == "OR": match = has1 or has2": koi ek bhi ho to match.
"else: match = has1 and not has2": NOT: word1 ho magar word2 na ho.
"if match:": match ho to title print aur results mein jama; aakhir mein len(results) kul ginti.
Output: "Search: agriculture AND irrigation", phir " - Agriculture and irrigation in Punjab" aur "Kul results: 1"; sirf isi title mein dono alfaaz hain.
Khud try karein: operator = "OR" kar ke Run karein: 3 results aayenge (Punjab wala, "Irrigation canals of Pakistan" aur "Agriculture of wheat"). "NOT" par sirf "Agriculture of wheat" aayega.
Advanced Search Features

Kai search engines advanced search features dete hain jin se results ko tareekh (date), jagah (location) waghera ke hisab se filter (chhaant) kiya ja sakta hai. In se sab se relevant aur taaza maloomat milti hai.

Misal: ek student “Pakistan's education policy” ki taaza khabrein dhoondna chahta hai. Woh advanced search feature se results ko “past year” (pichhla ek saal) tak filter kar ke sab se naye articles dekh sakta hai. (Kitab ki is line mein “a student in” ke baad jagah ka naam chhapne se reh gaya hai.)

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text:
1. Koi dilchasp topic chunein (maslan renewable energy, artificial intelligence ya history ka koi waqia).
2. Khaas (specific) keywords se online maloomat search karein.
3. Kam az kam teen sources dhoondein aur un ki reliability (bharose ke qabil hone) ko parkhein.
4. Jo mila us ka mukhtasar summary likhein aur apne sources ke links saath dein.

blocks.prompt: Class Activity ke baad: achhe summary mein kya kya hona chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Apne alfaaz mein topic ke basic facts, har source ke reliable hone (ya na hone) ki wajah (kis ne likha, kaunsa idara), aur har source ka link.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Kya aap jante hain ke duniya ki aadhi se zyada abadi internet istemal karti hai? Itni zyada maloomat maujood hai, is liye online achhi research karna seekhna aap ki parhai aur aage ki zindagi ke liye ek taqatwar tool hai.

blocks.prompt: Search results se koi lafz nikalne (exclude karne) ke liye kaunsa Boolean operator istemal karein? (MCQ 2)  Online search mein specific keywords kyun zaroori hain? (Short question 5)
blocks.explanation: MCQ 2: (c) NOT; kitab ke mutabiq NOT kisi term ko search se nikalta hai. (Kitab ki answer key (a) OR deti hai, jo ghalat hai; OR to dono mein se koi bhi lafz shamil karta hai.) Short question 5: specific keywords search engine ko theek batate hain ke aap ko kya chahiye, is liye relevant maloomat jaldi milti hai aur bekaar results kam aate hain; maslan sirf 'farming' ki bajaye 'organic farming'.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Search query khaas (specific) likhein; sahi keywords chunein.
AND dono alfaaz, OR koi ek, NOT lafz nikalta hai.
Advanced search features se date, location waghera ke hisab se filter.
